Hi Alice,

Thanks again for starting the Archer onboarding for Archer Security. Two quick asks from our side before we start bulk evidence uploads:

1) CAIQ delta: we maintain a CAIQ baseline in our internal inventory. To avoid duplicate Q&A rows during the bulk import, can you confirm the portal's unique key for CAIQ rows (is it question_id or question_text)? If you support importing a mapping CSV to merge on question_id we can provide a "delta mapping" CSV.

2) Presign flow for large artifacts: our ingest pipeline uses presigned URLs + short-lived temp credentials for multipart uploads. Can you share the exact presign response schema Archer expects (headers, required ACL, metadata keys) or the API doc link? We have a draft presign policy doc that lists required headers and a sample manifest.

We'll attach a draft mapping CSV and the presign policy if that helps. Once we've aligned we'll do a short 30-minute handoff to validate uploads with your portal team.

Thanks — Tessa

Hi Tessa,

Great questions — happy to clarify. Short answers:

- CAIQ dedup/merge: Archer uses question_id for canonical matching during imports. If you provide a mapping CSV with our question_id column we will dedupe and update answers rather than creating new rows. We can share the current question_id set for the CAIQ template if you need it.

- Presign schema: Our portal supports two upload modes: (A) simple presign (single PUT) and (B) multipart presign with temp STS tokens. For multipart we require the presign response to include: upload_url (per-part), part_number, expires_at (ISO8601), and an auth_token header name (we expect "x-archer-upload-token"). ACLs should be set to private. We also accept an upload manifest JSON with file checksums (sha256) and a metadata object: {source: string, evidence_type: string}.

I'll loop in the portal team (vendor-portal@archer-sec.com) and attach the CAIQ question_id export. If you can send your delta CSV mapped against our question_id that will speed the import.

Best,
Alice Nguyen
Customer Onboarding, Archer Security

Tessa — thanks for the mapping and the policy draft, reviewed with portal team. Quick clarifications below and a sandbox link: 

- CREATE behavior: yes — rows with no archer_question_id are created in the "Staging -> Pending" bucket for a human reviewer. We'll include a flag in the import report so you can surface pending items to your internal steward.

- Metadata preservation: We persist metadata at ingestion and include it in the portal object view and in the export. Your metadata keys will be preserved (we will namespace unknown keys under arch:metadata to avoid collisions).

- Rate limits and sandbox: presign endpoints are rate limited to 120 requests/min for onboarding orgs. Sandbox upload base: https://sandbox-uploads.archer-sec.com/upload (tokenized invites below).
